## Rule

Four corner-marker cells (all same color, call it C) define a rectangular region. Inside that rectangle, there are cells of color 2. Crop the tightest bounding box around the color-2 cells, recolor all 2s to C, and output that cropped sub-grid. Background outside the bounding box becomes 0.

Verified on all 3 train examples (2026-06-06). Note: the existing ONNX candidate (cost ~107k) already handles this task — see Attempts below for the f16 trick result.
